annotation.bound_parties_text: The standard is guidance said to be useful for robot and robotic device designers and managers and the robotics process automation industry, but it imposes no obligations.
annotation.bound_parties_quote: Robot and robotic device designers and managers
annotation.legal_effect_quote: BS 8611 gives guidance on the identification of potential ethical harm and provides guidelines on safe design
annotation.robot_provision_quote: Robots and robotic devices. Guide to the ethical design and application of robots and robotic systems
